reply_text:
Pree, I couldn't find the site for Pine Crossing. The only store name I can match is from your June 9 post in this channel, where you flagged "Pine Crossing" as the store whose appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. I found no store-to-site mapping for it in what I can search.

The onboarding ticket SUP-5102 lists six new Marrow Agrisupply stores (North Creek, Elm Junction, Prairie Bend, Mill Crossing, West Ridge, South Fork) and refers to a store address sheet, but Pine Crossing isn't on that list. Mill Crossing is close, but I wouldn't use it for the account sheet without checking. Hollis is the one who has been working the store-level issues, and the address sheet from the rollout is the likely source for the site.
